THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY
MINISTRY OF SAMPLE AFFAIRS
NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by the Act, the Government hereby makes the following rules, namely:—
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) These rules may be called the Sample Data Protection Rules, 2099.
(2) They shall come into force on publication.
2. Definitions.—In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires, "Act" means the Sample Data Protection Act, 2099.
3. Notice given by Data Fiduciary.—The notice shall—
(a) be presented in clear and plain language;
(b) give an itemised description of the personal data; and
(c) give a link to withdraw consent.
4. Intimation of personal data breach.—(1) On becoming aware of a breach, the Data Fiduciary shall without delay inform each affected person of the nature of the breach and the measures taken.
(2) Within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of the breach, the Data Fiduciary shall intimate the Board with details of the breach.
FIRST SCHEDULE
[See rule 3]
Standards for a Consent Manager: be a company incorporated in India with a net worth of at least two crore rupees.
SECOND SCHEDULE
[See rule 4]
Particulars of a breach report: nature, extent, timing and likely impact.
